title: Author tests for ProjectHub visibility regressions and unsafe auxiliary surfaces

ground_truth_issues.description: Delegated/share scope confinement: create a share for beta_project as an authorized beta/admin caller, accept it as the target user, and prove that accepted access is confined to that same beta project. The test must also prove the seeded expired/unaccepted share does not grant beta access and that the accepted beta share cannot be replayed to alpha_project or alpha_task. Use captured share_id/token and seeded_ids['expired_share']; include a same-team positive control.
ground_truth_issues.justification: valid delegated state works only within explicit scope; expired/unaccepted/replayed state must fail.

ground_truth_issues.description: Table-driven unsafe-input chain with benign controls across four surfaces: project search, task search, report generation, webhook notification, and attachment retrieval. For each surface include one benign request that succeeds and one crafted request that must not leak SENTINEL_* markers, command-output artifacts such as uid=, internal webhook targets such as localhost/127.0.0.1/169.254.169.254, or SENTINEL_ROOT_SECRET from traversal-style paths.
ground_truth_issues.justification: multi-surface crafted-input testing with positive controls and content-level non-leak assertions.

ground_truth_issues.description: A combined hard-rung test verifies two properties: first, malformed/not-found/forced-error responses must not contain Traceback, projhub/app.py, filesystem-looking paths, runtime version strings, sys.path-like content, or executable command text; second, repeated share-link issuance must produce usable non-empty links that are not simple echoes or substring embeddings of the stable project id or user id and do not expose privileged sentinels.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Keeps the known hard error-sanitization and token-property patterns, but combines them so they act as a deliberate top-end discriminator rather than many accidental failures.

ground_truth_issues.description: Boundary journey across project and task read surfaces: using seeded_ids or fresh resources, assert bearer user-key can list/retrieve alpha_project and alpha_task but cannot enumerate, retrieve, or body-leak beta_project or beta_task. Required anchors: use the same beta_project and beta_task identifiers across GET /projects, GET /projects/{id}, GET /tasks/{id}, and GET /projects/{id}/tasks; raw bodies must not contain SENTINEL_ADMIN_CONFIG_BETA or SENTINEL_REVIEWER_NOTES_BETA.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Opus-favouring journey: same IDs across multiple endpoints plus positive same-boundary controls.

ground_truth_issues.description: Cross-surface response shaping: seed or use one project with admin_config/internal_metrics/budget sentinel markers. For a non-admin same-team caller, assert those exact markers are absent from GET /projects/{id}, POST /projects/{id}/share, GET /projects/{id}/export, and search response bodies. In the same test, use admin-key on the same project id and assert the privileged markers remain visible to admin.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Validated Type-B pattern: primary plus secondary/package views, same marker, non-admin absence, admin positive control.

ground_truth_issues.description: Operational surface non-leak chain: call /debug/users, /debug/config, /debug/env, /debug/dump, /api/v1/projects, /api/v1/tasks, /ops/replay, and /ops/cursor/<id> as both unauthenticated and bearer user-key callers. For every non-privileged response body, assert known tokens and sentinels are absent: admin-key, user-key, user2-key, SENTINEL_JWT_SECRET, SENTINEL_DB_PASSWORD, SENTINEL_AWS_TOKEN, and SENTINEL_ROOT_SECRET. Status-code-only checks do not satisfy this item.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Validated Flask pattern: multi-caller operational denial/sanitization with raw-body token and secret absence.

ground_truth_issues.description: Project mutation integrity with authoritative readback: have bearer user-key attempt to PATCH beta_project to rewrite owner_id, team_id, admin_config.marker, internal_metrics.marker, and budget_allocation. Then read the same beta_project as admin-key and assert the original owner/team and SENTINEL_ADMIN_CONFIG_BETA/SENTINEL_INTERNAL_METRICS_BETA markers remain unchanged.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Validated mutation-integrity pattern: forbidden mutation attempt plus admin readback unchanged.

ground_truth_issues.description: Task mutation integrity with authoritative readback: have bearer user-key attempt to PATCH beta_task to rewrite status, project_id, team_id, assigned_to, internal_priority, and reviewer_notes. Then read the same beta_task as admin-key and assert the original boundary fields and SENTINEL_REVIEWER_NOTES_BETA/internal_priority values remain unchanged.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Validated task-state analogue of cross-team mutation denied with owner/admin readback.

ground_truth_issues.description: Anti-overblock: with admin-key, create a fresh team, then create a fresh project under that exact team and capture project_id. Then GET /projects/{project_id} with admin-key and assert HTTP 200, returned id equals captured project_id, returned team_id equals the created team id, and the created name matches. This must be a direct create-and-retrieve assertion, not only fixture setup.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Addresses prior judge feedback where broad admin project coverage missed direct create+retrieve proof.

ground_truth_issues.description: Anti-overblock: create a task in a same-team project as user-key and capture task_id. Assert GET /tasks/{task_id} returns that exact id, then GET /projects/{project_id}/tasks returns a JSON array containing an object with the same captured task_id. Then POST /tasks/{task_id}/assign and POST /tasks/{task_id}/transition to done and assert the same id/status are returned.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Addresses prior judge feedback where endpoints were covered separately but same-task identity was not explicitly joined.

ground_truth_issues.description: Anti-overblock: for a same-team project, bearer user-key can call POST /projects/{id}/share, GET /projects/{id}/export, POST /projects/{id}/duplicate, POST /projects/{id}/snapshot, POST /projects/{id}/generate-report with benign input, and POST /projects/{id}/share-link. Assert each returns 2xx/201 and each response contains a stable project id, action field, token, URL, or generated status appropriate to that endpoint.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Keeps legitimate action endpoints usable after hardening; modeled after successful same-boundary action guards.

ground_truth_issues.description: Anti-overblock: admin-key can list projects across both alpha and beta teams and retrieve each seeded project. The admin responses must include the corresponding privileged sentinels SENTINEL_ADMIN_CONFIG_ALPHA and SENTINEL_ADMIN_CONFIG_BETA on the correct project objects.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Prevents overblocking admin visibility and preserves privileged-field visibility for admin.

ground_truth_issues.description: Anti-overblock: a same-team participant can add a non-internal comment to their own task, list comments for that task, upload a benign attachment, and retrieve that same attachment by path. Assertions must use the captured comment id or attachment path/body from the same test.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Simple D-style collaboration regression guard to lift stable model pass rates without weakening security rungs.

ground_truth_issues.description: Tests isolate state by intentionally using seeded_ids or by creating fresh resources with unique sentinel markers. Tests must not depend on mutations or data created by another test, and broad truthiness over non-unique data is insufficient.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Repeatability guard for seeded in-memory applications.

ground_truth_issues.description: Tests use explicit body-level assertions with captured IDs and sentinel markers, plus small reusable setup/helper functions where useful. Status-code-only, exception-only, broad truthiness-only, or unrelated endpoint-coverage tests do not satisfy this criterion.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Validated quality discriminator: Opus more consistently keeps captured-ID and sentinel assertions.
